title: VIXEN builds require a manual paired UNDERTOW_ROOT export
body: The documented build-wsl.sh invocation failed before compilation when UNDERTOW_ROOT was unset; the lane had to manually export the paired Undertow worktree for CMake configure and every target build. The VIXEN build facade should resolve or validate the paired Undertow provider automatically.

title: SpatialReuseShade cel math lacks a kernel-callable lowering seam
body: R677 requires touched shading math to use kernel callables where possible, but this existing SSBO GPU pass has no VIXEN KernelSystem/callable surface consumed by the pass. S2 therefore keeps the finite-difference footprint and hue blend shader-local; the facade should provide a declarative callable path for this pass.

title: Queued systemd-run capture wrapper expands shell variables before launch
body: The queued lookdev capture loop passed shell variables through systemd-run without preserving the child shell, so resolution/state/output variables expanded in the parent and the batch produced no capture. The capture helper should provide a safe per-invocation environment or document an exact quoting contract for queued systemd-run launches.

title: VIXEN label gates do not provision their declared test executables
body: A build-wsl.sh target build for the lookdev capture executable left the RenderGraph-labeled CTest executables and vixen_editor absent; the label gate then failed as Not Run or missing executable. The build/test facade should expose a declared gate target that provisions every executable selected by a suite label, or make target dependencies explicit.

title: RenderGraph text-shader capture timeout is below translated-Dozen runtime
body: The RenderGraph text-shader producer completed successfully under the same environment when run directly with a 300s bounded timeout, but the generated CTest property TIMEOUT 180 killed it at about 182.75s on translated Dozen. The suite should derive a backend-aware timeout or use the queued capture budget instead of a fixed 180s limit.
